findings.title: Account UI error uses Java MessageFormat, not i18next placeholders
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from i18next placeholders ({{0}}, {{1}}, {{2}}) to Java MessageFormat ({0} and a {2,choice,...} pattern). Every other string in this account-ui bundle still uses {{name}} / {{0}}. The account console does not run these strings through MessageFormat, so the attribute name and limits are never substituted and the raw choice pattern is shown. The same 1<values fragment can also be parsed as an i18next/Trans tag and break rendering of the validation error.

findings.title: Admin UI error switched to Java MessageFormat placeholders
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size in the React admin UI bundle was rewritten from {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} to Java MessageFormat {0} plus a ChoiceFormat clause. Admin UI interpolates {{ }} (i18next), not java.text.MessageFormat, so this validation message will display literal {0}, {1}, and {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values} instead of the attribute name and limits. The embedded <values> can also be treated as a translation component tag.

findings.title: Lithuanian login TOTP step replaced with Italian
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 was replaced with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Users with the lt locale will see the wrong language on the authenticator setup step, and the previous Lithuanian wording (including the FreeOTP/Google Play links) is gone.

findings.title: Lithuanian account TOTP step replaced with Italian
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account theme was overwritten with the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". The account console will show Italian to Lithuanian users for the OTP setup instruction.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese account string replaced with Traditional Chinese
findings.body: totpStep1 in messages_zh_CN.properties was replaced with "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", which uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). The zh_CN login bundle and the rest of this file use Simplified Chinese, so mainland Chinese users get the wrong script for this OTP step.

findings.title: Missing English bundle aborts the verifier with RuntimeException
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() derives an English properties path and, on any IOException (file missing, unreadable, or path rewrite wrong), throws an unchecked RuntimeException. verify() only catches IOException from Files.readString, so a single translation whose English counterpart cannot be opened fails the whole Maven plugin instead of recording a message and continuing. That also skips duplicate-key and HTML results already collected for that file.
